# Test fixture provenance

Most fixtures here are hand-written minimal BPX documents. Two are trimmed
derivatives of About:Energy parameter sets (CC BY-SA 4.0), and each retains
the original attribution in its `Header.Description`:

- `lfp_18650_cell_BPX.json`
- `nmc_pouch_cell_BPX.json`

For the full source, license text and modification details, see
[`app/data/example_documents/about_energy/NOTICE.md`](../../app/data/example_documents/about_energy/NOTICE.md).
